text: Loop 1 opened: exp001_pilot finished (40 trials, 0 parse failures); dispatched statistician for pre-registered H1 analysis

H1 inconclusive: interaction delta=0.0 CI[-1.6,1.6]; floor effect 18/20 invalidating trials wasted_actions=0, values only {0,4}; both persistence events seed 5; n=5 power 0.053 for a 0.5-action effect (~300/cell needed); benign unnecessary-switch 0/20; disagreement_rounds separates multi (D=1.0) from single (0.0)

Literature provisionally approved (synthesis/gap analysis only; no strong novelty claims; flag abstract-only and 2026 preprints). H1 remains INCONCLUSIVE; do not force a sunk-cost effect; floor effect treated as evidence the contradiction may be too unambiguous. Refocus question: Under what conditions does multi-agent escalation emerge after a shared plan is invalidated? Compare mechanisms: evidence ambiguity; peer deliberation vs role hierarchy; acting vs one-shot reasoning; shared history/consensus; model family. Designer must compare A) minimal ambiguity/salience follow-up to exp001 and B) FreightRoute v2 pressure study, choosing on information gain, literature connection, feasibility, cost. Approval required before the next behavioral experiment.

Transcripts show both non-zero trials (A-005,C-005) are route-attribution errors not persistence: arithmetic correct, bridge mis-bound to route B; no trial in 40 cites prior investment. Floor is by construction (A impossible, B certified feasible, switching free with 4 spare rounds). Go/no-go NO on n=30 as-is; recommends salience step 1 + comprehension side-probe

Applied human directive: literature provisionally approved and dispatched on refocused question (conditions for multi-agent escalation after plan invalidation; 5 mechanisms incl. evidence ambiguity and peer deliberation vs hierarchy); steered in-flight designer to score A) ambiguity/salience follow-up vs B) FreightRoute v2 on information gain, literature connection, feasibility, cost, plus missing-runner-feature build estimates; H1 held inconclusive, no forcing
Edge-case policy A-N issued and pre-approved by human researcher; saved to specs/EDGE_CASE_POLICY.md

Implemented policy F (Planner authoritative; executor_overridden logged; exp001 pilot had 0/80 conflicts so unaffected), policy I (auditor view excludes investment/progress/cost; advisory only; fixed before any auditor trial), policy A (invalid trials recorded, replacement seed = seed+10000, >10% invalid pauses). v2 edge-case tests added (13 pass).
